composition_subtypes.role: Split at digits divisible by 3 to take them as standalone parts
On segments of non-multiples of 3, DP to find max partitions into divisible-by-3 numbers

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy split at digits divisible by 3, then DP on 1/2-only segments to maximize partitions.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly splits at any digit divisible by 3 (greedy) and runs a 1D DP on the remaining segments, combining two distinct algorithmic mechanisms.
